title: 对亚洲母亲无所不能的刻板印象(7)
desc: 对亚洲母亲无所不能的刻板印象(7)

paragraphs.en: In my conversations with friends, one line invariably emerges.
paragraphs.zh: 我和朋友们聊天，总会出现同一句话。

paragraphs.en: It goes something like: "If I have children, I want to do things differently, I'll break the cycle."
paragraphs.zh: 大意是：“如果我以后有孩子，我想换一种教育方式，打破这个循环。”

paragraphs.en: Then it's usually followed by: "But I worry that without that pressure I'll raise ungrateful and lazy children," and concludes with some horrified observation about the liberties that some of their white friends take with their parents.
paragraphs.zh: 紧接着通常会补上一句：“但我担心，如果没有这种压力，养出来的孩子会不懂感恩、懒惰懈怠。”之后，会带着一丝震惊，说起一些白人朋友和父母相处时随心所欲的样子。

paragraphs.en: My friends and I are now in our early 30s.
paragraphs.zh: 我和朋友们现在三十出头。

paragraphs.en: Babies are everywhere, and with babies come good intentions that will go awry.
paragraphs.zh: 身边不断有人迎来新生命，伴随着新生儿而来的，还有那些终将偏离预期的美好初衷。

paragraphs.en: For all the ways in which my friends have been disappointed by their mothers, it's striking how many of their mothers had tried to do things differently as well.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管朋友们大多曾对母亲感到失望，但令人感慨的是，她们的母亲当年也同样想换一种方式养育子女。

paragraphs.en: And yet here we are with all our bad feelings.
paragraphs.zh: 可我们，依旧背负着种种心结长大。

paragraphs.en: In the most intimate and intense form, maybe the fate of the mother is just the fate of all humankind: to have your best intentions unrecognised and your best efforts falter.
paragraphs.zh: 也许，母亲的宿命，本质上是全人类最私密、最强烈的宿命：一片苦心不被理解，倾尽努力，最后却难免落空。

paragraphs.en: We will love and disappoint our own children.
paragraphs.zh: 我们会爱着自己的孩子，也会让他们失望。

paragraphs.en: A new generation will come after us and new novels, films and poems will emerge in our wake.
paragraphs.zh: 下一代会接踵而至，属于他们的小说、电影与诗歌也会陆续诞生。

paragraphs.en: They will discover new narratives and themes – and inevitably, some of them will dissect our love, and our failures.
paragraphs.zh: 他们会挖掘新的故事与主题，而不可避免地，其中一部分作品，会剖析我们的爱，以及我们犯下的过错。
